in_hebrew.name: Harl
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Ruler, army leader
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Harl הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word hærl, which means army or warrior. In the Bible, Harl is a variant of the name Harold, which means 'ruler' or 'soldier of the army'.

in_greek.name: Harl
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Ruler, army leader
in_greek.long_meaning: Harl είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old English word hærl, which means army or warrior. In the Bible, Harl is a variant of the name Harold, which means 'ruler' or 'soldier of the army'.

in_latin.name: Harl
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Ruler, army leader
in_latin.long_meaning: Harl est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old English word hærl, which means army or warrior. In the Bible, Harl is a variant of the name Harold, which means 'ruler' or 'soldier of the army'.
